## Type
<!-- feat / fix / chore / docs / test / refactor / perf / style / ci / build / revert -->

## Linked tickets
<!-- e.g., T-P7-A1-IMAM-01, closes #123 -->

## Problem
<!-- What is broken / missing / needed? -->

## Solution
<!-- What does this change do? Architecture decisions? Tradeoffs? -->

## Testing
<!-- How was this verified? Unit / E2E / manual / screenshots / curl output -->

## Risk
<!-- Breaking change? Migration required? Rollback plan? -->

## Reviewers
- [ ] CR-B (peer review — Sonnet subagent or human)
- [ ] CR-C (architecture review — required for auth, billing, schema, cross-system contracts)

## Charter Compliance
- [ ] Changes comply with relevant [`ENGINEERING-CHARTER.md`](.github/wiki/ENGINEERING-CHARTER.md) sections — quick links: [§ 21 Common AI-Agent Mistakes](.github/wiki/ENGINEERING-CHARTER.md#21-common-ai-agent-mistakes-read-before-any-change) · [§ 4 Naming Conventions](.github/wiki/ENGINEERING-CHARTER.md#4-naming-conventions-master-reference) · [§ 6 Documentation Bar](.github/wiki/ENGINEERING-CHARTER.md#6-documentation-bar)

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass locally (unit + affected E2E)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` clean across affected workspaces
- [ ] `pnpm lint` clean
- [ ] No AI attribution in commits or comments (no Co-Authored-By, no "Generated by")
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] Docs updated if user-visible surface changed (`.github/wiki/` or `.github/docs/`)
- [ ] Breaking change flagged with `BREAKING CHANGE:` in commit body if applicable
- [ ] No secrets in diff (`gitleaks` ran clean locally)
- [ ] Bundle-size diff acceptable (<5% growth for web)
